text:
Mira: Heads-up 3: we need final signoff for the APAC marketplace bundle (AWS/GCP/Azure). Azure private offer has an extra legal checklist and GCP needs a region-specific image. Also MSI partner (SI-Team) wants the terraform module names.
Jonah: Which Azure checklist items are blocking?
Mira: Legal wants explicit telemetry disclosure + customer-managed key note in the offer metadata. Also need trial length pinned (Legal prefers 14 days).
Elena: For GCP the image is built but not tagged for asia-southeast1. We can retag and push today if we get the exact manifest entry.
SI-Team: FYI we will consume the terraform module as module.redwood_marketplace. Need artifact path + version. Can you include a sha256 checksum in manifest?
Kevin: I'll add checksum. Also question: should we list a hardware-accelerated SKU (A100) vs a standard one? That affects pricing tiers.
Mira: Prefer keeping two SKUs: "standard" + "gpu-accelerated". Sales wants separate billing lines.
Jonah: Ok. I'll coordinate SKU names with Sales Ops. Quick note on packaging layout:
```
manifest.yaml (offers: [aws,gcp,azure])
artifacts/
  aws/ami.json
  gcp/image.tar.gz
  azure/offer.zip
checksums.txt
```
Marketplaces require each entry to have region tags and a licenseId.
Elena: Can we reuse the i18n strings for the offer summary? We need EN/JP/KO at minimum for APAC.
Legal-bot: Reminder: telemetry disclosure must include what metrics are collected and storage location. Marking as required.
Mira: @Elena and @Jonah let's split tasks: Elena: retag GCP image + push manifest update. Jonah: draft SKU map + confirm trial length with Legal. Kevin: add checksum file and asset sizes. SI-Team: we'll send module path v0.2.
SI-Team: We'll need the terraform example for customers: include variables: sku, region, license_key.
Jonah: Draft SKU names: REDWOOD-MKT-STD, REDWOOD-MKT-GPU. Sales Ops to confirm by 4pm.
Elena: Pushed manifest with asia-southeast1 entry to staging bucket. Link: https://staging-catalog.redwood.internal/manifest-1745012345.yaml
Kevin: Uploaded checksums.txt and asset sizes. CI will validate on next pipeline run.
marketplace-bot: Staging publish queued. Checklist status: manifest=passed, checksums=passed, eula=i18n pending, sku=awaiting-salesops.
Mira: Great. One more: joint announcement sync3thru PR - Marketing needs a beta date. Can we target next Tuesday post-marketplace approve?
Jonah: If Sales Ops approves SKU today and Legal OKs telemetry wording by EOD, we can aim for Tuesday. I'll add a follow-up to marketing.
Mira: Thanks. Post any blockers here and I'll escalate to PM + Legal as needed. :party-popper:
